issues_found.description: TSK_WNRP_ASSESS_CONDITION uses rates_by_tier (qt_scaled) instead of fixed_time_minutes. Assessment tasks typically use FIXED time. However, this is a deliberate design choice: condition inspection time genuinely scales with quality tier (QT3 quick glance at 6ft, QT4 systematic scan at 3ft, QT5 critical multi-pass raking light). The 5 remaining assessment tasks correctly use fixed_time_minutes. No fix required.
issues_found.suggested_fix: None — deliberate design choice consistent with door RP TSK_DIRP_ASSESS_CONDITION pattern.

issues_found.description: task_count_summary shows total_tasks=47, total_unique_WNRP_tasks=42, total_shared_RRP_tasks=5. The transfer_breakdown adds to 44 (22+5+15+2=44), but notes say 2 NOT_APPLICABLE tasks — these are NC tasks NOT transferred (TSK_WIN_PREP_WOOD_FILL, TSK_WIN_PREP_ALUMINUM_ETCH), so they correctly do NOT appear in the 42 WNRP count. No error.
issues_found.suggested_fix: None — transfer_breakdown documents NC task disposition, not WNRP task count.

issues_found.description: Worst-case prep pool stacking = 4.37x (POOR 2.0 x L 1.40 x DH 1.00 x TDL 1.20 x H2 1.30) exceeds 4.0x flag threshold. This is an extreme worst case (large TDL double-hung at height in POOR condition). Realistic max is 2.0x. The production.json correctly flags this for estimator review. No fix required.
issues_found.suggested_fix: None — extreme worst case correctly documented with estimator review flag.

convention_compliance.detail: task_classification used (never task_class). severity uses critical/major/minor (never high/medium/low). CON_ prefix used (never CONS_). Phase values use setup/prep/prime/interstage/finish/cleanup (never protect/protection as phase). Units uppercase (EA, SF, LF, EA_ROOM, FIXED). skill_level values: helper/journeyman/lead.

completeness.detail: 42 WNRP tasks + 5 RRP shared tasks = 47 total. 6 material systems (3 primers + 3 fine-finish). 7 protection zones. 4 round configurations. All items present in SOP and production.

rp_specific_checks.detail: State-driven primer selection confirmed (substrate_state drives primer, not substrate type). Condition modifiers in prep pool only — never in coating pool. QT modifiers in coating pool (via rates_by_tier) — never condition. Glass masking mandatory regardless of method. Wall masking required for BOTH brush and spray in RP.
